head: 8c47eb73e4fb68116897c0d02933eafe54fa4e74
summary: Fixed all 10 review findings: resolved keyboard gesture target from Keyboard.FocusedElement for Ctrl+Enter, bounded RevealStatus to one line with tooltip and reserved headroom in 644 px MinHeight, captured row DataContext in menu.Tag on opening, eliminated duplicate path normalisation via LongPath.ToDisplay, and prevented false hidden notes on volume roots. Updated FsaWindowHook and WindowCases Test-R001 to rigorously exercise all matrix shapes (including long paths, folder symlinks, root rows, gesture execution, placeholder row disabling, competing selection, and mid-scan stops on large trees) and added status-visible budget checks to B-007 and B-008.

payload.summary: Fixed all 10 review findings: resolved keyboard gesture target from Keyboard.FocusedElement for Ctrl+Enter, bounded RevealStatus to one line with tooltip and reserved headroom in 644 px MinHeight, captured row DataContext in menu.Tag on opening, eliminated duplicate path normalisation via LongPath.ToDisplay, and prevented false hidden notes on volume roots. Updated FsaWindowHook and WindowCases Test-R001 to rigorously exercise all matrix shapes (including long paths, folder symlinks, root rows, gesture execution, placeholder row disabling, competing selection, and mid-scan stops on large trees) and added status-visible budget checks to B-007 and B-008.

obligations.how: Resolved row from (Keyboard.FocusedElement as FrameworkElement)?.DataContext when e.Parameter is null in OnCanOpenInExplorer and OnOpenInExplorer; added hook step in RevealMode focusing row container and executing command against Window target with InputGestures check; verified in Test-R001.

Made RevealStatus one bounded line (NoWrap, CharacterEllipsis, ToolTip bound to Text), raised window MinHeight to 644 px with updated comment, added FSA_HOOK_STATUS to hook, and added variants with status visible at minimum size to Test-B007 and Test-B008.
Handled ContextMenuOpening and Opened to copy row DataContext into menu.Tag and bound CommandParameter to Tag, preventing DisconnectedItem when live snapshots refresh during a scan.

Added all missing shapes to Test-R001: %TEMP%.txt, emoji file, dup without dot, tree root row, folder symlink, >260-char path, competing selection inner.bin; polled Wait-ExplorerSelection on case folder for reveal-root before decoy check.

Deleted Plan_JunctionOrSymlink_ExactItemFirst, renamed empty path test to Plan_EmptyOrWhitespace_ThrowsArgumentException, and covered placeholder row via hook step asserting MenuItem IsEnabled == false.
Removed direct command execution fallback in RevealMode, logged via='menu' or 'gesture', asserted via in Test-R001, and verified OpenInExplorer.InputGestures contains Ctrl+Enter.
Replaced duplicate \\?\ and \\?\UNC\ prefix stripping in ShellReveal.Plan with LongPath.ToDisplay(path), preserving single bare-drive check.
Skipped File.GetAttributes in ShellReveal.Walk when plan.Candidates.Count <= 1 (volume root), and added unit test Walk_VolumeRoot_HiddenAndSystemStayFalse asserting Hidden==false on C:\.
Built top case tree in Test-R001 using New-TopsTree (thousands of folders, >1s scan time) so Stop action reliably lands mid-scan without racing completion.

In Wait-ExplorerSelection and decoy check, extracted and compared leaf names from Item.Path alongside Item.Name so checks pass under Windows default of hidden file extensions as well as 8.3 short paths.

deviations: Window MinHeight was raised from 620 px to 644 px to reserve budget headroom for the 1-line RevealStatus TextBlock (SL-047), preserving the 20 px spare headroom so both list minimums (376 px) fit even with the status line visible at minimum size, as verified by B-007 and B-008.

tests.note: Ran full Core test suite: 296 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including all architecture rules and 36 ShellRevealTests.

Ran comprehensive R-001 window case covering 15 distinct reveal shapes (gestures, placeholders, roots, >260-char paths, folder/file symlinks, junctions, unaddressable names, decoy selection wait, and stopped top rows): all 76 checks passed cleanly.
Ran B-007 with reveal status line visible at minimum window size: all layout and row visibility assertions passed.
Ran B-008 with reveal status line visible at minimum window size on stopped scan of long path: all checks passed.
Ran C-002: completed large tree scan passed all checks.
Ran C-006: hook lifecycle and env cleanup checks passed.
Ran K-002: mid-scan cancel and kinds breakdown checks passed.
Ran published app on real %TEMP% (97,803 files): completed in 15.2 s with exit code 0.

files.why: Raised MinHeight to 644 px, bounded RevealStatus to one line (TextWrapping=NoWrap, TextTrimming=CharacterEllipsis, ToolTip bound to Text), bound MenuItem CommandParameter to Tag, and hooked ContextMenuOpening/Opened to capture row DataContext.
Resolved row from Keyboard.FocusedElement.DataContext when e.Parameter is null for Ctrl+Enter gesture support, and captured row in menu.Tag on opening.
Replaced duplicate prefix strip in Plan with LongPath.ToDisplay(path), and skipped File.GetAttributes in Walk when candidate count is 1 (volume root).
Removed redundant Plan_JunctionOrSymlink_ExactItemFirst, added Walk_VolumeRoot_HiddenAndSystemStayFalse, and renamed empty path test.

Removed direct command execution fallback, added gesture execution against Window target with InputGestures check, added placeholder row IsEnabled==false check, and supported recursive tree search and competing selection.
Added FSA_HOOK_STATUS support to display the status line during minimum-size tests in HoldForDrives.

Updated Test-R001 with all missing shapes (gesture, placeholder, root, long path, folder symlink, competing selection, addressable names, decoy selection wait), compared leaf names from paths for extension hiding and 8.3 short paths, used New-TopsTree for the stopped top case, and added status-visible variants to B-007 and B-008.
